name: cure-res-security-lane
note: L10 R2 security post (bld.cure-security-post) with a garden wall segment beside it at the real game camera: the courier stands in the vehicle lane under the canopy. Run with --matrix (high/low tier, zoom 1 and 0.5). Look for: booth glazing and roof beacons, canopy on four posts with the blue fascia, the lane clear for a vehicle, bollards, wall pillars and rail, sunk or floating parts, flicker, missing parts at the low tier (LOD2).
